description: This is a test class for the HiringManagerAPI in the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It contains unit tests for retrieving all hiring managers, and placeholders for create, delete, and their validation rules, ensuring the API behaves as expected in various scenarios.

classes.name: HiringManagerAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the HiringManagerAPI endpoints related to recruitment hiring managers within the OrangeHRM platform.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the getAll API method for retrieving all hiring manager records, using varied test case parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test case data for the testGetAll method from the specified YAML data source.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the create method throws a not implemented exception, indicating the feature is not yet supported.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies that getValidationRuleForCreate throws a not implemented exception.
